note: Read by 3ds/tools/bench.py. One entry per bench. kind: azahar_pic | azahar_stream | host_test | console_prof. host (console_prof): azahar | o3ds | n3ds | host (o3dsxl is read as o3ds). scenario: the azt_scenarios.json name (azahar kinds run it; console kinds copy its switches as a reference). cap in s. until: the log regex the build prints (copied from the scenario). log_metrics: regex with one capture group, pick last|first. gates: {metric, op, value} or {metric, op, ref: baseline} (baseline = earliest run of the bench with the metric). scene_match: substring of the prof scene key (null = all runs). legacy: scenarios no bench uses (status stays in azt_scenarios.json, not deleted). speed: turbo | normal, the speed the bench runs at (bench.py run --speed overrides it for one run; azt.ps1 -Speed). Azahar benches: normal (no scenario runs -Turbo today). Console and host benches: normal. Queries use it as the default. default: true (absent = true) shows the bench in bench.py list before the others; false is listed last. Spot benches (spot_*) are the defaults for every frame cost query. profiles: named switch words (prof | log | none) appended after the recipe on a console push (bench.py push_switches, push_3ds.sh --profile, go.ps1 -Profile). Default per kind: console_prof -> prof, azahar_* -> log. A bench may set "profile" to override.
